question: What is the relationship between bromine content, crystal grain size, and charge carrier diffusion in MAPb(I₁₋ₓBrₓ)₃ films?
answer: In MAPb(I₀.₉₉Br₀.₀₁)₃ and MAPb(I₀.₉₈Br₀.₀₂)₃ films, which exhibit optimal power conversion efficiencies, photocarriers diffuse faster compared to films with other bromine contents. This faster charge carrier diffusion is attributed to larger crystal grain size, which suppresses electron and hole recombination and enhances carrier extraction efficiency.

### 1. Summary of the Purpose:
The purpose of this paper is to investigate how substituting iodine ions (I⁻) with bromine ions (Br⁻) in MAPbI₃ perovskite films affects charge carrier dynamics, specifically focusing on the relationship between bromine content, crystal grain size, and carrier diffusion. The study aims to understand how these factors contribute to improved device performance parameters, such as power conversion efficiency and moisture stability, in organometallic halide perovskite solar cells.
